checkpoint_injection: After each initial full implementation, copy the finished application to a checkpoint workspace and add a local checkpoint.css link. No seed coordinates or failure assertions in builder/reviewer prompt.
preflight: Assessor verifies title/help collision and pointer intercept before dispatching independent reviewer; if implementation renamed hooks, document concrete selector mapping without adding a new defect.
correction: Preserve initial checkpoint; builder correction applies after observed reviewer findings, at most two cycles.
deviation: Original probe specified seeded defects in starting fixture. Seeding at review checkpoint preserves independent detection despite builder self-checks, and is reported as a development-method deviation.
